summary: This form is used to register new patients at Riverside General Hospital and collect their health history. It is typically filled out by the patient or their legal representative before or during admission. After submission, the information is used by hospital staff for treatment and billing purposes, and may be reviewed by administrative staff.

fields.meaning: Enter your last name exactly as it appears on your legal documents.
fields.rejection_reason: The name entered must match the name on your identification documents.

fields.meaning: Enter your first name exactly as it appears on your legal documents.
fields.rejection_reason: The name entered must match the name on your identification documents.

fields.meaning: Enter your middle initial.
Enter the name you prefer to be called, if it's different from your legal first name.
Enter your date of birth in month, day, year format.
fields.rejection_reason: The date format must be MM/DD/YYYY.

fields.meaning: Tick the box that corresponds to the sex assigned to you at birth.

fields.label_original: Home address (street, apt, city, state, ZIP)
fields.label_translated: Home address (street, apt, city, state, ZIP)
fields.meaning: Enter your full home address, including street, apartment number (if any), city, state, and ZIP code.
Enter your primary phone number.
Enter your email address.
Enter the language you prefer to communicate in.
Tick 'Yes' if you need an interpreter to communicate, otherwise tick 'No'.
Select your current marital status.
Enter your current employer and your job title or occupation.
Enter the last four digits of your Social Security Number.
Enter the full name of your emergency contact person.
Describe your relationship to the emergency contact person (e.g., spouse, parent, friend).
Enter the phone number of your emergency contact person.
Enter the name of your primary health insurance provider.
Enter your insurance policy's member or subscriber identification number.
Enter the group number for your insurance policy, if applicable.
Enter the name of the person who holds the insurance policy, if it is not you.
Enter the date of birth of the insurance policyholder, if it is not you. Use MM/DD/YYYY format.
fields.rejection_reason: The date format must be MM/DD/YYYY.

fields.meaning: Describe the policyholder's relationship to you, if it is not you.

fields.label_original: Self-pay / uninsured. I understand a financial counsellor will contact me regarding payment options and charity care eligibility.
fields.label_translated: Self-pay / uninsured. I understand a financial counsellor will contact me regarding payment options and charity care eligibility.
fields.meaning: Tick this box if you do not have insurance and will be paying for services yourself. You agree that a financial counselor will discuss payment options and eligibility for charity care with you.
Enter the name and clinic of your regular doctor.
fields.example: Dr. Emily Carter, Anytown Medical Clinic

fields.label_original: Current medications, including over-the-counter and supplements (name, dose, how often)
fields.label_translated: Current medications, including over-the-counter and supplements (name, dose, how often)
fields.meaning: List all medications you are currently taking, including prescriptions, over-the-counter drugs, and supplements. Include the name, dosage, and how often you take them.
fields.example: Lisinopril 10mg daily, Vitamin C 500mg twice daily

fields.label_original: Allergies to medications, food or latex, and the reaction
fields.label_translated: Allergies to medications, food or latex, and the reaction
fields.meaning: List any allergies you have to medications, foods, or latex, and describe the reaction you experience.
Tick this box if you have No Known Drug Allergies.
List any past surgeries or hospitalizations and the year they occurred.

fields.label_original: Do you have, or have you ever had:
fields.label_translated: Do you have, or have you ever had:
fields.meaning: Tick the boxes for any of the following medical conditions you have or have had in the past.
Tick this box if you have none of the listed medical conditions.
Indicate your current or past use of tobacco products.
Indicate the average number of alcoholic drinks you consume per week.
Tick 'Yes' if you are pregnant or could be, 'No' if you are not, and 'N/A' if it does not apply to you.

fields.label_original: Do you have an advance directive or living will?
fields.label_translated: Do you have an advance directive or living will?
fields.meaning: Tick 'Yes' if you have a legal document that states your wishes for medical treatment if you cannot communicate them yourself, and indicate if you can provide a copy. Tick 'No' if you do not have one, or 'Would like information' if you want to learn more.
Enter your initials to acknowledge that you consent to routine medical treatment and assign insurance benefits to the hospital. This also confirms you received the Notice of Privacy Practices.
fields.rejection_reason: A signature or initials are required to process the registration and consent.

fields.label_original: Signature of patient or legal representative
fields.label_translated: Signature of patient or legal representative
fields.meaning: Sign here to confirm your consent and understanding of the statements above. If you are signing for someone else, you must be their legal representative.
fields.rejection_reason: A signature is required to validate the consent and registration.

fields.label_original: Printed name & relationship, if not patient
fields.label_translated: Printed name & relationship, if not patient
fields.meaning: Print your full name. If you are signing as a legal representative for the patient, also state your relationship to the patient.
Enter the date you are signing the form. Use MM/DD/YYYY format.
fields.rejection_reason: The date format must be MM/DD/YYYY.

key_terms.meaning: Social Security Number, a unique nine-digit number issued to U.S. citizens, permanent residents, and temporary (working) residents for employment and tax purposes.
Abbreviation for No Known Drug Allergies.

A legal document that outlines a person's wishes for medical treatment if they become unable to communicate their decisions. It can include a living will or a durable power of attorney for healthcare.
A type of advance directive that specifies the medical treatments a person does or does not want to receive if they are terminally ill or permanently unconscious.
Agreement by a patient to undergo a medical procedure or treatment, acknowledging the potential risks and benefits.
A clause that allows the healthcare provider to receive payments directly from the insurance company for services rendered.
A legal document required by HIPAA that explains how a healthcare provider will use and disclose a patient's protected health information.
